fields.why: The headline claim is the rise in case counts per year (3, 4, 19, 45), an incidence-type count over time, so count/rate applies alongside the proportions; the brief lists 'counts' under binary/categorical, which is what B followed.

brief_issues: The brief puts 'counts' under binary/categorical and 'incidence' under count/rate; a rule that event counts per period (case counts over time) are count/rate would decide this.
